findings.text: `pnpm test -- <files>` forwards a literal `--` to `vitest run`, so vitest ignores the file filters and runs every unit test (4 files / 146 tests when this unit ran, all passing). The named Done-when command still exits 0; the filter only works without the `--` (`pnpm test <files>` or `npx vitest run <files>`). The `test` script lives in package.json, owned by phase-1-backend-foundation, and was not changed.

e2e evidence for AC-dm-10, AC-dm-11 and AC-dm-29 (rail numbers, '?' aria-expanded, rendered-text scan of screens and PDF) belongs to the frontend units and was not run here. This unit delivers the content and the unit tests for the content (24 questions, 8 blocks, 5 'não sei' questions, help text, forbidden terms in shared/content).

messages.text: shared/domain/types.ts is the contract for the engine modules. It exports: DIMENSION_KEYS/DimensionKey, QUESTION_IDS/QuestionId, QuestionDimension ('structure' is es1, not scored), Answers (missing key = unanswered, null = 'não sei', counts 0), CalculatorInput (money in cents; spendMode/spendParts/spendRange, newCustomersMode/newCustomers/newCustomersRange, averagePurchaseCents, purchasesPerYear and relationshipLength as string keys, marginPercent integer 0..100) plus EMPTY_CALCULATOR, DiagnosisInput, UnitEconomics (spend/new customers with origin measured|estimated|unknown, cacCents, ltvCents, exact ratio, exact paybackMonths, neverPaysBack for BR-dm-15), LockKey, ActionKey, SignalId, RiskResult, ConfidenceResult, DimensionResult { score, supportsStage, belowWarning }, DiagnosisResult (rulesVersion, stage, lock, dimensions, weakestDimension, unitEconomics, risks, confidence, plan) and the Rules type. Midpoints are in rulesV1.midpoints (spend 500/3.000/10.000/32.500/60.000 reais as cents, customers 5/20/65/200/400, purchases 1/2.5/5/9.5/15, years 0.4/0.75/1.5/3/5), checked by hand against the LTV of G2 (273,60), G3 (1.856,25) and G4 (1.500,00). If a field is missing for your modules, report it; this file was not edited by you.

Rules thresholds are named, not criteria lists: stageGates.stage2/stage3/stage4 hold the numbers, and the order of the criteria (RULE-dm-04: cac, mp / measure, ratio, payback, pc, re / mm, co, es) stays in stageGate.ts. Stage 4 'es' means the es1 answer >= rules.stageGates.stage4.minStructureAnswer (3). The answer-based risk triggers stay in riskSignals.ts: SIG-04 pc1 = 3, SIG-07 mm1 = 0, SIG-08 co2 = 0. rules.confidence.totalItems is 26 (24 questions + 2 calculator origins). Dimension 'cm' scores cm1 + cm2 + the ratio item (3 items, RULE-dm-02); 'mm' scores mm1 + mm2 only (es1 is excluded). Helpers in shared/content/questionBank.ts: ANCHOR_MAX, getQuestion, questionsOfBlock, questionsOfDimension, allowsUnknown, isQuestionId. Imports in shared use explicit `.ts` extensions (tsconfig allowImportingTsExtensions).

tests/fixtures/rulesV2.ts can spread rulesV1 and change one nested threshold, for example { ...rulesV1, version: 2, stageGates: { ...rulesV1.stageGates, stage3: { ...rulesV1.stageGates.stage3, minProductChannel: 70 } } }. The plan keys are ActionKey values; texts come from ACTION_CATALOG[key] (title, reason, howTo). Risk texts come from RISK_CATALOG / getRiskInfo(signalId) (title, cause, howToReduce) and riskCatalogIndex(id) gives the catalog order for the tie-break. Stage texts, LOCK_PHRASES, LAST_STEP_PHRASE and DIMENSIONS are in shared/content/stageContent.ts.

For diagnosisSchemas.ts: answer keys must be QUESTION_IDS (isQuestionId in questionBank.ts); a value is 0..3, or null only where allowsUnknown(id) is true (mp1, mp3, cm1, mm1, co1). currentBlock is 1..8 (block 1 = calculator 'Seus números', blocks 2..8 hold the questions, BLOCKS lists them). The calculator range and mode fields use the key lists exported from shared/domain/types.ts (SPEND_PART_KEYS, SPEND_RANGE_KEYS, NEW_CUSTOMERS_RANGE_KEYS, PURCHASES_PER_YEAR_KEYS, RELATIONSHIP_LENGTH_KEYS); marginPercent is an integer 0..100; newCustomers 0..1.000.000; money in integer cents with a ceiling.

Block numbers are 1..8: block 1 is the calculator (CALCULATOR_FIELDS and the option lists in shared/content/calculatorOptions.ts hold its labels and '?' help), blocks 2..8 come from BLOCKS and questionsOfBlock(). Each Question has text, help (for the '?' button, aria-expanded), four options with value 0..3 and unknownLabel (null = no 'não sei' option; only mp1, mp3, cm1, mm1, co1 have one; answering it stores null). For the e2e text scan of AC-dm-29 the forbidden patterns are /\bV[1-4]\b/i, /m[ée]todo\s+V4/i, /V4\s+Company/i, /\bPPA\b/i, /\bCREP\b/i and /vacina/i, the same as tests/unit/forbiddenTerms.test.ts.

Deferred checks: pnpm test:e2e for AC-dm-10 and AC-dm-11 (tests/e2e/questionnaire.spec.ts), AC-dm-29 (tests/e2e/result.spec.ts, scan of screens and PDF), and the content-driven rules ACs (AC-dm-18 to AC-dm-26, AC-dm-49) once the rules and evaluate units land. Also: `pnpm test -- <files>` ignores the file filters because of the literal `--`; if per-file runs matter for QA, use `pnpm test <files>` or fix the script in package.json (owned by foundation).
